# CATSCAN: Generated Browser Library Assets

Parent: [Browser Runtime](../CATSCAN.md)

## Target
Deliver reusable browser packages to the existing static application.

## Authority
- Owns generated delivery artifacts only.
- packages/reploid/src owns implementation; application adapters own composition.
- Doppler owns its pinned archive; its child charter governs verified delivery.

## Scope
- self/vendor/reploid generated by scripts/sync-reploid-library.js.
- self/vendor/doppler contains integrity-verified package assets.

## Contracts
Inputs:
- Canonical package source and the library sync script.
Outputs:
- Byte-preserving source copy and package-assets.json inventory.

## Invariants
- Never hand-edit generated implementations.
- No second agent, transport, configuration or improvement implementation.
- Asset hashes identify bytes; generation does not prove runtime acceptance.

## Acceptance
- Installed-package and application browser acceptance must use matching package bytes.
- Evidence: [package acceptance](../../tests/library-package-acceptance.js).

## Non-goals
- Independent runtime policy or package publication.

## Freedom
Preserve canonical ownership, byte identity and acceptance boundaries.
